sections.content: Use por eso to introduce a consequence. A completed action can be followed by por eso + another statement: Ha llovido, por eso hemos vuelto. Por eso means 'that is why' or 'therefore'.

items.spanish: Ha llovido, por eso hemos vuelto.
items.english: It has rained, so we have returned.

items.spanish: Ha cambiado el tiempo, por eso hemos vuelto.
items.english: The weather has changed, so we have returned.

items.spanish: Nos hemos mojado, por eso hemos vuelto.
items.english: We have got wet, so we have returned.

items.spanish: Hemos vuelto, por eso estamos en casa.
items.english: We have returned, so we are at home.

sections.content: Use porque to answer 'why?' and por eso to show a consequence.
